name: Evans Electric Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1951, Evans Electric Ltd is in the business of Electro Mechanical Repairs & Servicing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) EEL is in the field of repair, refurbishment, support services and maintenance of large Motors, Generators, and Transformers. Heavy industries require Larger Electrical Machines because when these machines get older; the scope for the repair and maintenance increases 
b) The company is branching out into allied fields closely associated with its 3 heavy electrical products of large Motors Generators and Transformers, as the routine work of regular overhaul and repair is getting competitive
c) At present, the company is doing sitework of a large turbo generator
d) It is also continuing with the sitework on a large DC motor armature
e) The company is looking to work with  marketing agencies that can procure technically challenging high value orders and with limited competition.
f) Company provides import substitution on costly foreign made Apparatus and also does in-house development and manufacture of costly replacement components

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.9%
cons: Company has high debtors of 155 days.
Working capital days have increased from 71.6 days to 139 days
